overview: A companion moon in the Dathomir system tied to Nightsister orbital rituals.
history:
Dathomir Sister Moon appears in records spanning the Old Republic, Clone Wars, Imperial era, Galactic Civil War, and Legacy periods. Archaeological surveys, holocrons, and veteran testimony preserve its place in galactic history.

Strategic value, cultural identity, and Force-sensitive traditions on Dathomir Sister Moon shifted with each regime—from Sith occupation to Republic restoration and beyond.
significance: Dathomir Sister Moon remains a reference point in Outer Rim Territories surveys, trade lane charts, and military campaign planning across the nine saga films, series, KOTOR, and the Old Sith Empire.
